0.en: At noon, Lena's voice went out over every speaker in town again, as calm as a bus timetable. Six weeks of food, at careful portions. Twenty liters of water, in two windows. Nobody goes past the end of any road. She read it twice. When the speakers clicked off, somewhere across the street from the utility station a man shouted something that sounded like a question, and got no answer.
0.id: Tengah hari, suara Lena kembali menyebar lewat setiap pengeras suara di kota, setenang jadwal bus. Enam minggu makanan, dengan porsi hemat. Dua puluh liter air, dalam dua sesi. Tidak ada yang melewati ujung jalan mana pun. Ia membacakannya dua kali. Ketika pengeras suara berbunyi klik dan mati, di suatu tempat di seberang jalan dari stasiun utilitas seorang laki-laki meneriakkan sesuatu yang terdengar seperti pertanyaan, dan tidak mendapat jawaban.

1.en: Behind the station, in a gravel yard between two tanks, Mark made them practice.
1.id: Di belakang stasiun, di halaman berkerikil di antara dua tangki, Mark menyuruh mereka berlatih.

2.en: He laid the rope out on the ground in a long straight line and tied one end to a railing. Then he clipped Jack, Aiden and himself onto it at intervals, with a harness each from the security stores.
2.id: Ia membentangkan tali di tanah dalam satu garis lurus panjang dan mengikat salah satu ujungnya ke pagar besi. Lalu ia mengaitkan Jack, Aiden, dan dirinya sendiri ke tali itu dengan jarak tertentu, masing-masing memakai harnes dari gudang keamanan.

3.en: The railing is the cart. The gravel is the road. That drain over there is the edge. Nobody goes past the drain.
3.id: Pagar ini keretanya. Kerikil ini jalannya. Saluran pembuangan di sana itu tepiannya. Tidak ada yang melewati saluran itu.

6.en: Then it'll be very easy to stay away from.

7.en: They walked up to the drain and back. Then they did it again. Lena had set a bucket of water on the far side. Jack reached out over it with the pole, slowly, and soaked the sponge, and brought it back without letting it swing. Aiden held the funnel, and Mark twisted the sponge in both hands until it ran clear.
7.id: Mereka berjalan sampai ke saluran itu lalu kembali. Lalu mengulanginya. Lena sudah menaruh seember air di seberangnya. Jack menjulurkan tiang di atasnya, pelan-pelan, merendam spons, lalu menariknya kembali tanpa membiarkannya berayun. Aiden memegang corong, dan Mark memeras spons dengan kedua tangan sampai tak ada lagi yang menetes.

8.en: The first time, most of it went on Mark's boots.
8.id: Pertama kali, sebagian besar airnya membasahi sepatu bot Mark.

9.en: The second time, most of it went in the jug.
9.id: Kedua kali, sebagian besar airnya masuk ke jeriken.

10.en: The third time, Mark said a single word without warning, loud and flat.
10.id: Ketiga kali, Mark mengucapkan satu kata tanpa peringatan, keras dan datar.

12.en: Jack froze with the pole halfway up. Aiden froze with the funnel against his chest. A drip ran down the pole and hung from the end of it, and nobody moved until Mark spoke again.
12.id: Jack membeku dengan tiang terangkat setengah. Aiden membeku dengan corong menempel di dadanya. Setetes air mengalir menuruni tiang dan menggantung di ujungnya, dan tak ada yang bergerak sampai Mark bicara lagi.

13.en: Good. That's the word. When I say it, you're a fence post. You don't look around. You don't ask why. You stop.
13.id: Bagus. Itu katanya. Kalau aku mengucapkannya, kalian jadi tiang pagar. Jangan menoleh ke sekeliling. Jangan tanya kenapa. Berhenti.

17.en: What if you don't say go?
17.id: Bagaimana kalau kamu tidak bilang jalan?

18.en: Then you're a fence post for a very long time.
18.id: Berarti kalian jadi tiang pagar lama sekali.

19.en: They did it eleven more times. By the last one, Jack's arms were shaking, and the bucket was nearly empty, and he could have done it in his sleep. Which, Mark pointed out, was the point.
19.id: Mereka mengulanginya sebelas kali lagi. Pada kali terakhir, lengan Jack gemetar, ember hampir kosong, dan ia sanggup melakukannya sambil tidur. Yang mana, kata Mark, memang itu tujuannya.

20.en: The young officer the radio called Unit Four came by in the late afternoon to learn the knots. He was barely older than Aiden, with a careful way of standing, as though he expected to be told he was in the wrong place.
20.id: Petugas muda yang dipanggil Unit Empat lewat radio datang menjelang sore untuk belajar simpul. Ia nyaris tak lebih tua daripada Aiden, dengan cara berdiri yang hati-hati, seolah menduga akan diberi tahu bahwa ia berada di tempat yang salah.

21.en: Mark handed him the end of the rope.

22.en: You hold this. You don't let go of it. If I yell pull, you pull.
22.id: Kamu pegang ini. Jangan dilepas. Kalau aku teriak tarik, kamu tarik.

24.en: If you see something coming that we don't, you say so. You don't wait to be sure.
24.id: Kalau kamu melihat sesuatu datang yang tidak kami lihat, bilang. Jangan tunggu sampai yakin.

26.en: Mark looked at him for a second longer.

27.en: And you don't call me sir.

29.en: Doctor Mercer came to the house at eight, as she had promised, and set her bag on the kitchen table. Sarah was already sitting with her sleeve rolled up.
29.id: Dokter Mercer datang ke rumah pukul delapan, sesuai janjinya, dan menaruh tasnya di meja dapur. Sarah sudah duduk dengan lengan baju tergulung.

31.en: I lay on that couch all day. I watched cameras. I watched Jack drill water into a bucket on Lena's feed. I've never been so bored in my life.
31.id: Saya berbaring di sofa itu seharian. Saya menonton kamera. Saya menonton Jack berlatih memindahkan air ke ember lewat tayangan Lena. Seumur hidup saya belum pernah sebosan ini.

33.en: She wrapped the cuff around Sarah's arm and watched the numbers. Jack watched her face. It didn't change.
33.id: Ia melilitkan manset di lengan Sarah dan memperhatikan angka-angkanya. Jack memperhatikan wajahnya. Raut itu tidak berubah.

36.en: Same as better, or same as high?
36.id: Sama dengan lebih baik, atau sama dengan tinggi?

37.en: Same as high. Not worse. I'd have liked better. I'll take same.
37.id: Sama dengan tinggi. Tidak memburuk. Saya berharap lebih baik. Sama pun saya terima.

38.en: Then she handed Sarah a small cup and a test strip and pointed down the hall. When Sarah came back, Doctor Mercer held the strip under the kitchen light for a long moment.
38.id: Lalu ia menyerahkan sebuah wadah kecil dan selembar strip tes kepada Sarah dan menunjuk ke ujung lorong. Ketika Sarah kembali, Dokter Mercer mengangkat strip itu di bawah lampu dapur cukup lama.

39.en: No protein. That's good. That's the one I was watching for.
39.id: Tidak ada protein. Itu bagus. Itu yang saya waspadai.

41.en: So I can stop being bored?

43.en: Doctor Mercer turned to Jack and held out her hand, palm up. He gave her his left one without being asked. She looked at the stitches, then at him.
43.id: Dokter Mercer menoleh ke Jack dan mengulurkan tangannya, telapak menghadap ke atas. Jack memberikan tangan kirinya tanpa diminta. Ia memeriksa jahitannya, lalu menatap Jack.

44.en: I hear you're going to be holding a wet pole in the morning.
44.id: Saya dengar besok pagi Anda akan memegang tiang basah.

46.en: She was already pulling a surgical glove out of her bag.
46.id: Ia sudah mengeluarkan sarung tangan bedah dari tasnya.

47.en: Everything travels. It's a very small town. If that gets wet, you come straight to me. Not after you've made your report. Straight to me.
47.id: Semuanya cepat menyebar. Ini kota yang sangat kecil. Kalau itu basah, Anda langsung datang ke saya. Bukan setelah Anda menyerahkan laporan. Langsung ke saya.

48.en: She worked the glove over his hand, then a clear plastic bag over that, and taped it at the wrist.
48.id: Ia memasangkan sarung tangan itu ke tangan Jack, lalu kantong plastik bening di atasnya, dan merekatkannya di pergelangan.

50.en: After she had gone, Sarah sat on the couch with her tablet propped on her knees and made him go through it again. The time. The rope. The cart. The word.
50.id: Setelah ia pergi, Sarah duduk di sofa dengan tablet bersandar di lututnya dan menyuruh Jack mengulang semuanya. Waktunya. Talinya. Keretanya. Kata itu.

51.en: And if the spider's out early?
51.id: Dan kalau laba-labanya keluar lebih awal?

52.en: We stop. We wait. If it doesn't go back, we come home.
52.id: Kami berhenti. Kami menunggu. Kalau dia tidak kembali, kami pulang.

53.en: And if the radio goes quiet?

55.en: And if you see a bigger drop two meters farther in?
55.id: Dan kalau kamu melihat tetesan yang lebih besar dua meter lebih ke dalam?

58.en: Lena told me everything. Answer the question.
58.id: Lena sudah cerita semuanya. Jawab pertanyaannya.

60.en: She held his eyes for a long moment, and then she nodded, and set the tablet down, and leaned against him.
60.id: Sarah menatap matanya lama, lalu mengangguk, meletakkan tabletnya, dan bersandar padanya.

61.en: Jack thought about leaving her on this couch with a number that wouldn't come down, and going to stand under a spider. He didn't like the shape of it. He liked the shape of three weeks of water even less.
61.id: Jack memikirkan soal meninggalkan Sarah di sofa ini dengan angka yang tak mau turun, lalu pergi berdiri di bawah laba-laba. Ia tidak suka bentuknya. Tapi ia lebih tidak suka lagi bentuk air untuk tiga minggu.

62.en: Then sleep. You can't hold a pole straight if you've been awake for two days.
62.id: Kalau begitu tidurlah. Kamu tidak bisa memegang tiang dengan lurus kalau sudah dua hari tidak tidur.

63.en: He meant to argue. He was asleep before he had figured out how.
63.id: Ia berniat membantah. Ia sudah tertidur sebelum tahu caranya.

64.en: The alarm went at a quarter to five. Mark was outside at half past five, with the motor running and the headlights off.
64.id: Alarm berbunyi pukul lima kurang seperempat. Mark sudah di luar pukul setengah enam, dengan mesin menyala dan lampu depan mati.

65.en: The edge of town was completely dark. The streetlights burned along the inner roads, the way Lena had left them, but every porch light near the edge was out, and every window along the western blocks had its blinds down. Mark drove by the streetlights as far as they went. He drove the last stretch slowly, by memory, with a small red lamp cupped in one hand and pointed straight down at the road just ahead of the wheels.
65.id: Tepian kota gelap gulita. Lampu jalan menyala di sepanjang jalan-jalan bagian dalam, seperti yang ditinggalkan Lena, tapi setiap lampu teras di dekat tepian sudah dimatikan, dan setiap jendela di sepanjang blok-blok barat tirainya diturunkan. Mark menyetir mengikuti lampu jalan sejauh lampu itu ada. Ruas terakhir ia tempuh pelan-pelan, mengandalkan ingatan, dengan lampu merah kecil yang ditangkupkan di satu tangan dan diarahkan lurus ke bawah, ke jalan tepat di depan roda.

66.en: Nobody spoke. Aiden sat in the back with the jug between his knees and the funnel in his lap. Unit Four sat beside him, holding the coil of rope like it might try to leave.
66.id: Tak ada yang bicara. Aiden duduk di belakang dengan jeriken terjepit di antara lututnya dan corong di pangkuannya. Unit Empat duduk di sampingnya, memegangi gulungan tali seolah tali itu bisa mencoba pergi.

67.en: The white maintenance cart came out of the dark ahead of them, pale and square. Beyond it, there was nothing. Just a deeper black where the grass began.
67.id: Kereta pemeliharaan putih itu muncul dari kegelapan di depan mereka, pucat dan kotak. Di baliknya, tidak ada apa-apa. Hanya hitam yang lebih pekat di tempat rumput dimulai.

68.en: Mark stopped twenty meters back and cut the motor.
68.id: Mark berhenti dua puluh meter di belakangnya dan mematikan mesin.

69.en: For a moment, the only sound was the engine ticking as it cooled.
69.id: Sesaat, satu-satunya suara hanyalah detak mesin yang mendingin.

70.en: Then the rest of it arrived. A clicking somewhere in the stems, dry and slow, like someone tapping a fingernail on wood. A faint, steady hum that came and went. Far away, a long low creak, like a tree leaning in the wind.
70.id: Lalu sisanya datang. Bunyi klik di suatu tempat di antara batang rumput, kering dan lambat, seperti seseorang mengetukkan kuku ke kayu. Dengung samar yang mantap, datang dan pergi. Jauh di sana, derit panjang yang rendah, seperti pohon yang condong ditiup angin.

71.en: Unit Four's voice was very small.

73.en: Mark kept his eyes on the dark.

74.en: Nothing is normal. That's just loud.
74.id: Tidak ada yang normal. Itu cuma berisik.

75.en: They got out without slamming a single door. Mark tied the rope off at the cart's tow hitch, tested it with his whole weight, then tested it again. Jack clipped in at the front, Aiden behind him, and Mark last, nearest the cart. Unit Four stood at the cart with a turn of the rope around the hitch and the end wrapped twice around his forearm, ready to haul.
75.id: Mereka turun tanpa membanting satu pintu pun. Mark mengikatkan tali ke kait derek kereta itu, mengujinya dengan seluruh bobot tubuhnya, lalu mengujinya lagi. Jack mengaitkan diri di depan, Aiden di belakangnya, dan Mark paling akhir, paling dekat ke kereta. Unit Empat berdiri di kereta dengan satu lilitan tali di kait derek dan ujungnya dililitkan dua kali di lengan bawahnya, siap menarik.

76.en: Jack lifted his wrist and spoke as quietly as he could.
76.id: Jack mengangkat pergelangannya dan berbicara sepelan mungkin.

77.en: Station, this is Bennett. We're at the cart.
77.id: Stasiun, ini Bennett. Kami di kereta.

79.en: Station hears you. Two minutes, starting now.
79.id: Stasiun mendengar. Dua menit, mulai sekarang.

80.en: Sarah came on the line, softer.
80.id: Sarah masuk ke sambungan, lebih lembut.

81.id: Aku sedang berbaring. Tanya saja siapa pun.

85.en: They walked forward together to the end of the asphalt, the three of them in a line, and stopped where the road stopped. Then they waited.
85.id: Mereka berjalan maju bersama ke ujung aspal, bertiga dalam satu barisan, dan berhenti di tempat jalan berhenti. Lalu mereka menunggu.

86.en: The sky went from black to charcoal. Charcoal to gray.
86.id: Langit berubah dari hitam ke kelabu arang. Kelabu arang ke kelabu.

87.en: Somewhere out on the island, a bird began to sing. It was an ordinary song, bright and sweet, the kind Jack had heard every spring of his life. It went on and on, until he could hear it through Lena's channel on his wrist as well as through the air.
87.id: Di suatu tempat di pulau itu, seekor burung mulai berkicau. Kicauan biasa, cerah dan manis, jenis yang Jack dengar setiap musim semi sepanjang hidupnya. Kicauan itu terus dan terus, sampai ia bisa mendengarnya lewat kanal Lena di pergelangannya selain lewat udara.

90.en: Mark didn't look away from the grass.
90.id: Mark tidak mengalihkan pandangan dari rumput.

92.en: I don't know. I can't tell anymore.
92.id: Aku tidak tahu. Aku sudah tidak bisa membedakannya.

93.en: Lena's voice came in, right on time.

94.en: Two minutes. You all still there?
94.id: Dua menit. Kalian semua masih di sana?

96.en: Out of the gray, the stems took shape. The wall of grass. The pale curve of a blade bending toward them over the road. And along the blade, one by one, the drops.
96.id: Dari kelabu itu, batang-batang rumput mulai berbentuk. Dinding rumput. Lengkung pucat sehelai daun yang membungkuk ke arah mereka di atas jalan. Dan di sepanjang helai itu, satu demi satu, tetesan-tetesan air.

97.en: They came out of the dark the way stars do, not appearing but simply being there once you knew how to look. Small ones along the edges, a whole row of them, like beads on a wire. Then larger ones further up. And at the very tip of the nearest leaf, hanging out over the last meter of asphalt, three meters up, a single drop as tall as Jack's chest, round and heavy and perfectly still.
97.id: Tetesan-tetesan itu muncul dari kegelapan seperti bintang, bukan muncul tiba-tiba melainkan sekadar sudah ada di sana begitu kita tahu cara melihatnya. Yang kecil-kecil di sepanjang tepi, sederet penuh, seperti manik-manik di seutas kawat. Lalu yang lebih besar di bagian yang lebih tinggi. Dan di ujung paling akhir daun terdekat, menggantung di atas meter terakhir aspal, tiga meter di atas tanah, satu tetes setinggi dada Jack, bulat dan berat dan diam sempurna.

99.en: That one's the plant's. At the tip.
99.id: Yang itu air tanamannya. Yang di ujung.

100.en: Jack looked at the pole in his hands. Then at the drop. Then at the distance between them.
100.id: Jack memandang tiang di tangannya. Lalu tetesan itu. Lalu jarak di antara keduanya.

102.en: Above it, high in the stems, where the gray hadn't quite reached, something pale hung in the shadows. It didn't move.
102.id: Di atasnya, tinggi di antara batang-batang rumput, di tempat kelabu belum sepenuhnya sampai, sesuatu yang pucat tergantung dalam bayang-bayang. Benda itu tidak bergerak.

103.en: Mark's voice was barely a breath.
103.id: Suara Mark nyaris hanya embusan napas.

104.en: Ten minutes of gray. Then the sun.

105.en: Jack set his boots right at the line where the road ended, the toes of his boots on the last finger's width of asphalt, and lifted the pole toward the water.
105.id: Jack menapakkan sepatu botnya tepat di garis tempat jalan berakhir, ujung-ujung sepatunya di atas selebar jari terakhir aspal, lalu mengangkat tiang ke arah air itu.
